goal: Reject unknown or misspelled options in the sendall RPC call
Prevents unintended spending of all wallet UTXOs when options like inputs are misspelled
Avoids accidental transaction broadcasts when options like psbt or add_to_wallet have typos
agreement: Verified by testing that option validation works as expected (vicjuma)
Suggestion to add a release note remains open (kevkevinpal)
Approval from an account with no project history and no stated reason (Conradgabe)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it prevents silent fund loss and accidental transaction broadcasts caused by option typos
Misspelling inputs currently causes sendall to spend all wallet UTXOs instead of a specified subset
